import hashlib,json,os,resource,signal,subprocess,sys,time
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from pathlib import Path
from devtools.reference_validator.benchlab_panel import _host

root=Path.cwd();base=root/'devguide/evidence/reference_validator_remaining_topology_v1'/sys.argv[1]
protocol=base/'protocol.json';spec=json.loads(protocol.read_text());policy=spec['resources']
os.sched_setaffinity(0,{min(os.sched_getaffinity(0))})
for key in ('OMP_NUM_THREADS','OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS','MKL_NUM_THREADS','NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS','RAYON_NUM_THREADS'):os.environ[key]='1'
host=_host();assert host['safe'],'Insufficient conservative host reserve'
source=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain','--','devtools/reference_validator'],text=True).strip()
def limits():
 resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(2*1024**3,2*1024**3))
 resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(policy['cpu_soft_seconds'],policy['cpu_hard_seconds']))
command=[sys.executable,'-m','devtools.reference_validator.capture_power_cells',str(protocol.relative_to(root)),str((base/'receiving').relative_to(root))]
record={'recorded_at_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'source_revision':source,'command':command,'resource_policy':policy,'cpu_affinity':sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0)),'host_samples':[{'elapsed_seconds':0,'host':host}],'supervisor_source':Path(__file__).read_text()}
begin=time.perf_counter();before=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN);stop_reason=None;termination=None
with (base/'execution.log').open('xb') as log:
 p=subprocess.Popen(command,stdout=log,stderr=log,preexec_fn=limits,start_new_session=True)
 while p.poll() is None:
  try:p.wait(timeout=5)
  except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:pass
  elapsed=time.perf_counter()-begin;host=_host();record['host_samples'].append({'elapsed_seconds':elapsed,'host':host})
  if not termination and (not host['safe'] or elapsed>policy['wall_seconds']):
   stop_reason='host_pressure' if not host['safe'] else 'wall_limit';p.send_signal(signal.SIGTERM);termination=time.perf_counter()
  if termination and time.perf_counter()-termination>120 and p.poll() is None:
   os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGKILL)
 end=p.wait()
after=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
record.update(exit_code=end,stop_reason=stop_reason,elapsed_seconds=time.perf_counter()-begin,child_cpu_seconds=after.ru_utime+after.ru_stime-before.ru_utime-before.ru_stime,peak_child_rss_kib_linux=after.ru_maxrss,receiving_status='completed' if end==0 and (base/'receiving/receipt.json').is_file() else 'incomplete',log_sha256=hashlib.sha256((base/'execution.log').read_bytes()).hexdigest())
record['files']={str(p.relative_to(base)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in (base/'receiving').rglob('*.json')}
(base/'execution.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in record.items() if k not in ['host_samples','supervisor_source','files','command']}),flush=True)
if end:print((base/'execution.log').read_text()[-3000:]);raise SystemExit(end)
